quotes.partner_name: This GP Participation Agreement is entered into as of March 1, 2026 between Example Fund GP LLC (the "General Partner") and Sample Family Office LLC (the "Partner"). (p.1)
quotes.scope: This Agreement governs solely the Fund's investment in the property known as Granite Ave Industrial (the "Property"), and no other investment of the Fund. (§1.2)
quotes.capital_pct: The Partner shall fund fifty percent (50%) of the GP Commitment allocable to the Property, and the General Partner shall fund the balance. (§2.1)
quotes.promote_pct_of_gp_side: The Partner shall be entitled to forty percent (40%) of the Promote distributed to the General Partner in respect of the Property. (§3.1)
quotes.fees: The Partner shall not be entitled to any fee. All asset management, acquisition, disposition and other fees are payable to the Sponsor. (§4.1)
quotes.effective_date: This Agreement is effective as of March 1, 2026. (§5.1)
